title: What's New: Analyze Performance Issues with Scheduled Profiles (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction and Background on In-Client Performance Profiling

features.name: In-Client Performance Profiler
features.description: Interactive tool for investigating performance issues across extensions directly inside the web client. Users can start recording, perform reproduction steps, stop, and inspect results to identify performance bottlenecks.
caveats: Cannot profile web service calls or background sessions like job queues
Requires user collaboration to capture profile

features.name: Scheduled Profiles
features.description: Automatic, non-interactive performance profile capture based on well-defined rules. Runs in the background allowing partners to analyze profiles after users perform their tasks, supporting both user actions and web service calls.
caveats: Profiles are retained for a configurable period before deletion
Requires defining trigger rules before execution

features.name: Profile Schedule Configuration
features.description: Interface for defining rules for automatic profile capture including enable/disable toggle, start and end times, user selection, profile type (browser activity or background tasks), sampling frequency, activity duration threshold, and retention period.
caveats: Activity duration threshold needs to be set appropriately to avoid excessive profiling

features.name: Performance Profiles Page
features.description: Page that displays all captured performance profiles for viewing and analysis. Can be filtered by specific schedule or rule set to focus on particular scenarios.
caveats: Without filtering shows all profiles regardless of schedule
Results view is identical to in-client profiler results

features.name: Technical Information and Call Tree Analysis
features.description: Detailed analysis capability within profile results showing time spent by application objects, page extensions, and call trees to identify where time is consumed in code execution.
caveats: Requires interpretation of technical data to identify root causes

features.name: Opening Visual Studio Code from Web Client
features.description: Feature allowing developers to navigate directly from the web client to Visual Studio Code to investigate code for the functionality being viewed, enabling quick code inspection from performance analysis.
